name: com.etiklar/eu-supplement-compliance
title: Etiklar EU Supplement Compliance
description: Check EU food supplement pages and labels against EU Reg 1924/2006, 432/2012 and DGCCRF law.

tools.name: check_eu_health_claims
tools.description: Use this when checking, reviewing, or rewriting food supplement product descriptions, labels, landing pages, ads, or social posts for EU health claim compliance (Reg. 432/2012, 1924/2006, 1169/2011 Art. 7(3), LFGB/HCVO) in Polish (pl), French (fr), Italian (it), or German (de). Detects prohibited disease claims, Abmahnung risks, and unauthorized promises, extracts ingredient doses and % NRV, and returns exact authorized replacement sentences from the EU register. Do not use for prescription drugs or cosmetics.

text.description: Full product description, label text, or marketing copy including ingredients and doses.

market.description: Target EU market rules: pl (Poland/GIS), fr (France/DGCCRF), it (Italy/Ministero), de (Germany/HCVO/Abmahnung), or auto.

product_name.description: Optional product name to improve context matching.

tools.name: lookup_eu_register_432
tools.description: Use this when looking up exact authorized EU Regulation (EU) 432/2012 health claims, conditions of use, and minimum 15% NRV serving thresholds for a vitamin, mineral, or food substance (supports English, German, Polish, French, and Italian substance names such as 'magnesium', 'vitamin D', 'melatonin', 'collagen', 'ashwagandha'). Returns official consolidated wording in pl, fr, it, or de. Do not use to audit a full marketing paragraph: use check_eu_health_claims for that.

language.description: Official EU register wording language to return (pl, fr, it, or de).

topic.description: Optional keyword filter inside claim text (e.g. 'zmeczenia', 'fatigue', 'sonno', 'Mudigkeit').

tools.name: scan_supplement_product_page
tools.description: Use this when the user provides a public HTTPS product page URL of a food supplement store in Poland, France, Italy, or Germany and wants to detect unauthorized health or disease claims on that page. Fetches the public HTML safely and returns the top findings with legal basis and EU 432/2012 replacements. Do not use for non-public URLs or when the user already pasted the text.

url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of a single supplement product page.

market.description: Target market (pl, fr, it, de) or auto-detect from URL and page language.

tools.name: check_eu_compliance_readiness
tools.description: Use this when planning a food supplement launch or compliance audit in Poland (GIS), France (DGCCRF/Compl'Alim), Italy (Ministero della Salute), or Germany (BVL/NemV/UWG Abmahnung) across own e-commerce stores, Allegro, Amazon, social media, or AI shopping feeds. Do not use to audit specific copy sentences: use check_eu_health_claims instead.

product_type.description: Primary ingredient profile of the supplement.

channels.description: Sales and marketing channels to include in the checklist.
